phrases: at the butcher's
在肉店，表示在肉店这个地点
Were you at the butcher's?
你在肉店吗？
I was at the butcher's yesterday.
我昨天在肉店。
at the greengrocer's
在蔬菜水果店，表示在蔬果店这个地点
I was at the greengrocer's.
我在蔬菜水果店。
She buys vegetables at the greengrocer's.
她在蔬菜水果店买蔬菜。
How are you keeping?
你身体怎么样？用于询问健康状况
How are you keeping?
你身体怎么样？
Very well, thank you. How are you keeping?
很好，谢谢。你身体怎么样？
be absent from
缺席；不在，常与学校、工作地点等连用
Was he absent from school last week?
他上周没上学吗？
She was absent from work yesterday.
她昨天没来上班。
spend the weekend
过周末，指在周末进行某种活动
We're going to spend three days in the country.
我们将在乡下度过三天。
They spent the weekend at the beach.
他们在海边度过了周末。
stay at my mother's
住在我妈妈家，表示暂住在亲属家中
We're going to stay at my mother's for the weekend.
我们将在妈妈家过周末。
She stayed at her aunt's last night.
她昨晚住在她阿姨家。
in the country
在乡下/农村，指离开城市到乡村地区
Friday, Saturday and Sunday in the country!
周五、周六和周日都在乡下！
They live in the country.
他们住在乡下。
Aren't you lucky!
你们真幸运！表示羡慕或感叹的语气
Aren't you lucky!
你们真幸运！
Aren't we lucky to have such good weather!
天气这么好，我们真幸运！
very well
很好，表示状况良好，常用于回答 How are you?
He's very well, thank you.
他很好，谢谢。
I'm very well, thanks.
我很好，谢谢。
be going to
表示将来计划或打算做的事情
We're going to spend three days in the country.
我们将在乡下度过三天。
What are you going to do tomorrow?
你明天打算做什么？

grammar.k: be动词的过去式一般疑问句
grammar.d: 用was/were构成的一般疑问句，用来询问过去的情况 询问某人或某物在过去某个时间的状况或位置，回答用Yes, ... was/were. 或 No, ... wasn't/weren't.
ex: Was he absent from school last week?

grammar.d: 在was/were后加not构成否定句 表示某人或某物过去不在某种状态或位置，was not可缩写为wasn't，were not可缩写为weren't
ex: They weren't at school on Monday.

grammar.k: be going to 表示将来计划
grammar.f: 主语 + am/is/are going to + 动词原形 + ...
grammar.d: 用be going to结构表示将来打算或计划要做的事 表示已经决定或计划好的将来行为，比一般现在时表示的将来更强调主观计划
ex: We're going to spend three days in the country.
我们将在乡下度过三天。
She's going to stay at her grandmother's.
What are you going to do at the weekend?

patterns.p: Were you at the + 地点?
im: Were you at the post office?

patterns.p: Was he absent from + 地点/活动?
o: Was he absent from school last week?
im: Was she absent from work yesterday?
Was Tom absent from class today?
Were they absent from the meeting?

patterns.p: We're going to + 动词原形
o: We're going to stay at my mother's for the weekend.
我们将在妈妈家过周末。
im: We're going to spend the holiday in the mountains.
They're going to visit their uncle next week.
他们下周将去看望叔叔。
I'm going to travel around Europe this summer.
今年夏天我打算环游欧洲。
